title: Market-implied team strength for US sports
items: US sports (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, College Football) had no squad-value equivalent because salary caps make roster prices meaningless. They now derive team strength from championship odds — the market's own valuation of each team.
This is the honest equivalent of soccer squad values, sourced live from the odds already fetched, replacing rough rank estimates.
Still market-anchored, not yet per-sport calibrated — that needs a full season of results, which the pick log is now collecting.
